column1: # The reserve's policy: what the fleet keeps whole and the pull levels of its goods. What the fleet means to build are
# the open needs of game/needs.tsv (written by game/fleet/needs.py, each division its own; rule F24): surplus.py takes
# them as the reserve's targets and holds every stored good against them and this file; what neither takes is surplus
# that the fleet sells (`surplus.py show`; `surplus.py check` and `needs.py check` are the gates).
# Kept by the Fleet Admiral with Logistics (rule F24); where a base stands and when a step is paid is Suggi's.
# kind: keep (an item id; units a number, or `all` = never surplus) | keepkind (a kind of item, units `all`)
#       max (an item id; units = the most the fleet gathers of it) | min (an item id; units = the level below which it
#       is gathered again): the pull levels of the dispatcher's pull rule (game/fleet/pull.py), which closes a route
#       that only brings goods of the reserve while each holds its max. Without a line: max = what the reserve asks of
#       the good, min = 90 percent of max. They reserve nothing.
# A target (facility, hull or item) is a need: `needs.py add`, never a line here (`needs.py check` fails one here).
# A facility's earlier steps (upgrades_from) are needs of their own: the script adds nothing by itself.
